discription: A short, percussive pluck sound generated by a sine wave with a rapid decay envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pan=0;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.perc(0.005, 0.8, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    sig = SinOsc.ar(freq);    sig = sig * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan));}
